verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an approvals list where 'decisions that need a human land' and states you can 'approve the big calls from your phone,' plus a live agent status view showing 'the last thing it said,' implying some visibility into task progress and pending human input. However, there's no explicit documentation of a push/email/Slack notification mechanism that proactively alerts a developer the moment a task completes or needs input — the evidence only shows a pull/status-list model. Missing for 10: explicit notification/alert channel (push, email, Slack), confirmation of real-time proactive alerts rather than a passive dashboard.
